snippet.title: Tactical Assault VR | Cinematic Trailer | Virtual Reality CQB
snippet.description:
Tactical Assault VR is a virtual reality game centered around CQB (Close Quarters Battles). Experience some of Virtual Reality's most intense PVE battles against punishing Enemy Ai. Play solo or coordinate with your squad in multiplayer PVE coop. Featured 4-player crossplay between PCVR and stand-alone headset users or up to 8-player dedicated PCVR coop on Steam.

Tactical Assault VR is currently an early-access title.

Available on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2314160/Tactical_Assault_VR/?beta=0

Available on Meta AppLab:
https://www.meta.com/experiences/5190911237633299/

Credits:
Cinematic Trailer by @liv Productions
Directed by: @DemoAkuro 
Produced by: @TougeVR
